name: B10-0294/2026 (The Left) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking for action. It condemns Belarus for holding people in prison for their political views, including Aliaksandra Pulinovich, a young woman detained at 16. It asks Belarus to release all political prisoners and drop restrictions on those freed. It asks the European Union and its member states to give Belarusians who flee persecution visas, protection, identity documents and access to services.

- The Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus; no law changes.
- It asks the European Union and member states to offer visas, protection and documents to fleeing Belarusians.
- It asks its President to send the resolution to European Union institutions, member states, the United Nations Special Rapporteur on Belarus and the International Labour Organization.
